sealed_record.thesis: jukan05 relayed on 2026-10-05 that China's YMTC - a NAND producer with every incentive to talk supply up, not down - told The Wire China it expects the NAND shortage to last another three years. When the marginal low-cost competitor publicly concedes a three-year shortage, the sell-side model of NAND oversupply by end-2027 is simply wrong. TrendForce corroborates from the other side: DRAM scarcity is capping NAND suppliers' enterprise SSD output, keeping eSSD undersupplied through 2026. Kioxia is the highest-beta listed NAND pure-play and is still valued on a mid-cycle multiple rather than a three-year contract-price ramp.

outcome.thesis_note: DITUTUP -54.8%. Ditutup dalam AI trade unwind 17 Nov. Sempat terhapus dari ledger pagi itu dan dikembalikan karena ide ini sudah ter-commit di track record.
